newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank says to be more active on forex markets.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank says to be more active on forex markets.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Wednesday it would increase its buying and selling activity on the currency markets to increase the stability of the crown.
"These interventions are not intended to defend any pre-set level for the crown," Riksbank spokesman Michael Wallin told Reuters.
"Neither should they be seen in the context of possible preparations for ERM entry," he added.
The central bank will not be commenting on its possible intervention, Wallin said. - Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1006
